scope: Offline desktop prototype; synthetic and three operator-local camera-derived sample inputs

environment.device: MPS for camera-derived neural runs; CPU for synthetic/tests

upstream_codec_crosscheck.frontend_only_change: select RGB_NONE and pass null RGB destination; no upstream codec modifications

limits: Input-sample PSNR is not proof of denoising accuracy
Synthetic linear box reduction is not physical binning or VC-5 LL1
Single-frame noise estimate is not independent sensor calibration
Generated grain is not original recovered noise
Peak RSS includes framework and I/O buffers; MPS samples are not certified peaks
Timings include startup/I/O/model loading and are not sustained camera rates
No held-out real-scene quality certification is claimed
